name: dogfood-stripe-billing-app
description: Dogfood app v1.23-2 — a Stripe advanced billing RP for Next.js 15 App Router that exercises checkout session + webhook signature verify + subscription lifecycle + invoice + 3DS + dunning. Drivable in both KIWA_MODE=real (Stripe testcontainers + real Stripe API) and KIWA_MODE=mock (@kiwa/payment createStripeMock + 9 axis semantics) so behavioural fidelity feeds the release gate.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/payment -F @kiwa/core build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
